back: A testable explanation stating the expected relationship between variables, with a reason.
The specific result expected if the hypothesis is correct, stated in terms of the measured variables.
Volume of stock = (concentration wanted ÷ stock concentration) × total volume; make up to the total with water.
Each solution is made by diluting the previous one by the same factor (e.g. 1 cm³ + 9 cm³ water for tenfold).
Grams of solute per 100 cm³ of solution (5% = 5 g in 100 cm³).
Systematic: all readings shifted the same way. Random: unpredictable scatter about the true value.
Two means: t-test. Counts against expected: chi-squared. Relationship: Pearson (continuous, normal, linear) or Spearman (ranked).
Nominal: unordered categories. Ordinal: ordered categories. Continuous: measured on a scale.
